tax.text: He said he would extend the Trump-era tax cuts, eliminate taxes on tips and Social Security benefits, and oppose wealth and unrealized-gains taxes.
tax.quote: I will work in Congress to extend the Trump-era tax cuts, pass the "No Tax on Tips Act," pass a "No Tax on Social Security Benefits Act," and achieve U.S. Energy Dominance. I will actively oppose Wealth Tax and Unrealized Gains Tax policies.

debt.text: He agreed that the government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt. Strongly Agree

housing.text: He opposed placing new multifamily housing in established single-family neighborhoods without greater deference to existing zoning plans.
housing.quote: I oppose all efforts to “infill” or “shoehorn” new multi-family units into traditionally single-family residential areas without more consideration placed on the original zoning intent, or Master Plan.

schools.text: He strongly supported vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools. Strongly Agree

safety.text: He strongly opposed redirecting police funding to community programs.
safety.quote: I support redirecting funds from police departments to community programs. Strongly Disagree

immigration.text: His campaign calls for stronger borders, defunding sanctuary cities, and deporting all immigrants who are in the country illegally.
immigration.quote: Drive and introduce legislation to fortify and secure U.S. Sovereign Borders, while concurrently defunding sanctuary cities and deporting all illegal  immigrants, without exception.

guns.text: He called gun ownership a civil right and opposed all laws restricting guns or ammunition.
guns.quote: I oppose attempts to prohibit ownership of guns by law-abiding citizens and stand against all laws that restrict guns or ammunition.

abortion.text: He said he opposes abortion in every form and for every reason, without exceptions.
abortion.quote: I believe all human beings have God-given legal personhood from fertilization to natural death, without exception. I am against abortion in any form, for any reason.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly opposed allowing biological males to participate in women's sports or enter women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison. Strongly Agree

cannabis.text: In a 2023 municipal questionnaire, he opposed legalizing recreational marijuana in Colorado Springs.
cannabis.quote: Do you support the legalization of recreational marijuana in Colorado Springs? No.

health.text: He called for abolishing taxpayer-funded health care and gradually phasing out Medicaid and Medicare for future generations.
health.quote: Taxpayer funded health care should be abolished in all forms, and Medicaid and Medicare should be defunded (gradually phased out for upcoming generations).

energy.text: He pledged to end green-energy funding, expand natural-gas production, and support nuclear and geothermal energy.
energy.quote: To focus on Fiscal Responsibility, I will vote for the Trump-Vance Administration initiative to terminate all Green New Scam funding, and concurrently, enhancing the production of natural gas, and its derivatives, such as Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG).

voting.text: He supported requiring proof of citizenship to register and government-issued photo identification to vote in federal elections.
voting.quote: I support the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) America Act, which would require documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote and government-issued photo identification to cast a ballot in federal elections.

tax.text: Crank voted for legislation extending tax cuts and said it would strengthen the economy.
tax.quote: This bill will deliver for the American people by securing our borders, extending tax cuts, unleashing American energy, and making our nation stronger than ever before.

trade.text: Crank said he generally opposes tariffs because consumers ultimately pay them through higher prices.
trade.quote: I generally oppose tariffs on foreign goods because those tariffs end up being paid by the American consumer in the form of higher prices.

debt.text: Crank said Social Security and Medicare growth must be addressed while protecting current recipients and considering different arrangements for future beneficiaries.
debt.quote: But then there's a whole host of things like social security and Medicare and other things that are on autopilot. They just keep growing and we do have to address that.

housing.text: Crank said he is working to reduce construction regulations that raise housing costs.
housing.quote: That is why I am leading efforts to cut burdensome home construction regulations in Colorado and across the country that unnecessarily raise the costs of construction and home prices.

schools.text: Crank joined an amicus brief defending a federal tax-credit scholarship program covering public, private secular and religious schools.
schools.quote: Congress enacted ECCA to provide choices to families and to advance religious liberty, not religious discrimination.

safety.text: Crank secured proposed federal funding for a new rescue vehicle used by the El Paso County Sheriff's Office.
safety.quote: The purchase of the new vehicle will ensure our community does not lose this critical capability.

immigration.text: Crank voted for the Laken Riley Act and said people covered by it should be detained and deported.
immigration.quote: This act will ensure that illegal aliens, such as Laken Riley’s murderer, are detained and deported before they have the opportunity to commit heinous crimes.

guns.text: Crank opposed waiting periods, magazine limits, assault-weapons bans, firearm taxes, and other gun restrictions.
guns.quote: I oppose waiting periods, magazine limits, so-called “assault” weapons bans, additional taxes on ammunition or firearms, and other forms of gun control.

abortion.text: Crank said he would support a federal abortion ban containing exceptions for rape, incest, and the mother's life.
abortion.quote: If legislation is put forward in Congress that bans abortion but has an exception for rape, incest or life of the mother, I will support such legislation.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Crank voted to bar federally funded elementary and middle schools from socially transitioning children without parental approval and to block federal funding for gender-identity instruction.
gender.quote: The Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act ensures parental consent remains at the forefront of our children’s lives by prohibiting federally funded elementary or middle schools from socially transitioning a child—such as changing their name, pronouns, or bathroom access—without parental approval.

health.text: Crank voted against extending enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies and called for greater competition and consumer choice.
health.quote: Congress needs to focus on real reforms that lower costs, improve and expand competition so consumers have real choices.

energy.text: Crank called for loosening restrictions on oil and gas production on federal public lands.
energy.quote: The federal government should loosen restrictions on oil and gas production on public lands.

voting.text: Crank advocated nationwide voter-identification requirements, proof of citizenship for registration, signature verification, and voter-roll maintenance.
voting.quote: First, we should institute voter ID laws in every state. You should not be able to cast a vote without a valid government ID.

tax.text: Killin supports cutting middle-class taxes while raising the tax burden on wealthy people and large corporations.
tax.quote: Make giant corporations and the very wealthy pay their fair share of taxes while cutting taxes for the middle class

trade.text: Killin wants to end tariffs she considers irrational and harmful to Colorado consumers and businesses.
trade.quote: End irrational tariffs that are raising prices and creating uncertainty for hardworking Coloradans

debt.text: Killin pledges to protect Medicare from further cuts while strengthening the program's finances.
debt.quote: Protect Medicare from further cuts and ensure the long-term financial stability of the program

housing.text: Killin supports incentives to increase the supply of housing, especially entry-level homes.
housing.quote: I would work to lower our housing costs by creating incentives that will increase supply, especially entry-level housing, in the Pikes Peak region and improve access for first-time home buyers.

immigration.text: Killin supports securing the border and deporting violent criminals while creating legal status for law-abiding immigrants.
immigration.quote: Congress must focus on actually fixing the problem by securing our border, deporting violent criminals, and providing law-abiding immigrants a pathway to legal status.

guns.text: Killin supports gun-safety restrictions intended to keep firearms away from dangerous people while respecting responsible ownership.
guns.quote: Jessica also supports commonsense gun safety measures that respect the rights of responsible gun owners while helping keep firearms out of dangerous hands.

health.text: Killin supports reversing Medicaid cuts that would reduce public health coverage.
health.quote: Repeal Medicaid cuts that will kick hundreds of thousands in our state off health care and force all Colorado families to pay more

energy.text: Killin prioritizes reducing energy costs through investment in more affordable production.
energy.quote: Lower energy costs by investing in more affordable energy production
